snippet.title: Galaxy Brain Move Before Coffee
snippet.description:
Example play through of Meme Mash, available now at https://www.airheadgames.com.

🖼️ About Meme Mash
Each round starts with a blank meme template. Everyone fills it in with their best, most original answers. Then it's remix time: sift through the wild pile of responses to find the hidden gems and rebuild the meme. 

You earn points every time someone uses your answer in a remix. At the end, the player with the most points earns the title of Supreme Meme Lord—and all the pretend power that comes with it.

🎈 About Airhead Games
Airhead Games are quick, multiplayer party games that never play the same. Your dynamic host, Poppy, makes every game feel deeply personal by calling out players by name, riffing on answers, and weaving your group into the game. It's endless fun for your Twitch stream, team ice breaker, or friendly game night.
